notes: Only rows of events judged day-level (srcb_sources.day_level_events) are output; the rest of Tennis My Life is dated by event, as Stage 0's rule C05 notes.

TML gives calendar days without times and does not say which calendar. Measured against the venue's day from api_tennis / the Live Tennis API (agreement_with_timed_sources_venue_day) they are the venue's day at events in Oceania (all) and Europe, Africa and Asia (about 93%), but not in the Americas, where most late matches carry the next day and no single calendar fits. date_basis is 'local' only in the first regions; in the Americas and where the zone is unknown it is 'utc_date', meaning 'not the venue's day' (TML gives no time to convert). Some WTA events are off by more.
The TML rows linked here also give the ATP player code -> Stage 0 id crosswalk used for Infosys.
event_date/event_time read as Europe/Berlin wall-clock (api-tennis.com's documented default; the handoff's fetcher settings are not published) - see tz_checks.
Cancelled fixtures, doubles, team ties and identical duplicate rows are left out.
Qualifying rounds are labelled from the end (Final = last qualifying round).
scheduled_time_utc of v1.0.0 is Israel wall-clock time (Zenodo v1.0.2, 28 Sep 2026): converted from Asia/Jerusalem to UTC here. Scheduled, not actual, start.
No scores in the index: links are confirmed by round only (score_agrees is null).
The Sackmann crosswalk is used only where Stage 0 knows the id under a compatible name.
Open Tennis Data's dates come from tennis-data.co.uk (its 'source' column cites it on every row): agreement with tennis-data is not an independent check.

Like tennis-data, its day is the UK calendar day of the match (measured: 99.8% in the Americas against 75% for the venue's day). That is the venue's day only in Europe, Africa and Asia, where date_basis is 'local'; in the Americas, Oceania and where the zone is unknown it is 'utc_date' (the UK day, within an hour of UTC; no time is given to convert).

Date is the charter's match date (read as the local day). 'Time' is free text; where it reads as a clock time (24-hour times before 09:00 left out as am/pm-ambiguous) and the event's zone is known, it is taken as local wall-clock time and given as start_utc. Unverified.
No scores in the metadata: links are confirmed by round only.
No time of day in the records (match_date and match_status.matchDate only).

Joined on ATP tournament number and season with ATP player codes first, then names; the date is kept only if it lies from 1 day (main draw) or 10 days (qualifying) before the tournament date to the level's plausible end, else date_local is null.
Round from the ATP match number (MS001 final, MS002-003 semi-finals ...); qualifying numbers are not read.

findings: api_tennis: the UK calendar day of the start equals tennis-data's date for 99.99% of 9,486 matches; the venue's day does for 99.54% outside the Americas and 73.51% in the Americas. tennis-data.co.uk dates a match by the UK calendar day (inference): late matches in the Americas carry the next day there.

live_tennis_api: the UK calendar day of the start equals tennis-data's date for 99.82% of 18,660 matches; the venue's day does for 99.32% outside the Americas and 74.89% in the Americas. tennis-data.co.uk dates a match by the UK calendar day (inference): late matches in the Americas carry the next day there.
api_tennis read as Europe/Berlin and the Live Tennis API read as Asia/Jerusalem give the same UTC start to within 15 minutes for 99.98% of 40,344 shared matches.
tml_days: same venue day as api_tennis / Live Tennis API for 75.72% of 1,903 shared matches (one day off 23.28%, more 1.0%).
match_charting: same venue day as api_tennis / Live Tennis API for 94.49% of 4,244 shared matches (one day off 5.18%, more 0.33%).
infosys: same venue day as api_tennis / Live Tennis API for 98.46% of 36,748 shared matches (one day off 1.49%, more 0.04%).
open_tennis_data: same venue day as api_tennis / Live Tennis API for 92.14% of 19,085 shared matches (one day off 7.85%, more 0.02%).
